# agentic-canvas

A shared whiteboard for diagrams, drawn by people and agents.

Keywords: whiteboard,canvas,diagrams,drawing,collaboration,agents,mcp,cli.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-canvas".
- CLI: agentic-canvas summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-canvas mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-canvas
- Core contract: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-canvas/blob/main/docs/agentic-core.md
